title: Observe the installed DWF typed native milestone authoring contract without mutating the accepted plan
commitMessage: test: qualify installed DWF milestone authoring availability for Math M8

contribution.summary: Independently inspect the DWF Payload SDK actually loaded by RS180 for typed milestone/work-package authoring and record an exact receipt before Math M8 admission.
contribution.value: Distinguish current upstream DWF source capabilities from the installed 0.1.66 executor. Probe EnsureMilestoneSubtree, EnsureWorkPackageSubtree and the typed node specification by public CLR signatures. Preserve the completed 541-node M0-M7 plan, backlog and all historical packages.
debtChanges: RS179 completed at attempt 001 with first-pass success. M8-M12 are owner-approved direction and proposed topology only, not admitted into the canonical DWF plan.
Math's current generated DWF Payload SDK reference does not document typed milestone/work-package creation; upstream DWF GitHub source now implements both methods.
RS180 does not assume that upstream source equals the installed executable. Absence of a method is reported as unavailable, not mislabeled as qualified.
The run adds a Math-owned evidence receipt only; no product completion, AURA operation, retroactive plan rebaseline or package mutation is authorized.
contribution.nextAction: If the typed APIs are installed, prepare a separately bounded M8 admission with fully reconciled backlog and native plan; otherwise qualify a compatible DWF upgrade first.

preconditions.expectedValue: docs: qualify proposed M8-M12 Math roadmap and DWF topology gate
